'''Coronet Ion Works''' was a company that was headquartered in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> the Empire captured the company's [[Coronet Ion Works corporate headquarters|corporate headquarters]] and converted it into a major communications command post. However, the Imperial forces inside were later eradicated by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in a systematic, floor-by-floor attack devised by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rian Darok]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coronet Ion Works was first mentioned in a Codex entry on Darok entitled "The Rogue Lord's Accomplice" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
